basis.epistemic_boundary: Only findings with an exact available case, issue, pull request, commit, or source reference are individually named. Reported counts whose individual source rows are unavailable remain count-only groups and cannot receive release credit.

unavailable_report.effect: The report's aggregate count is retained from the reconciliation, but its unnamed rows are not reconstructed or treated as enumerated evidence.

release_credit_rules.rule: A defect or obligation receives release credit only after its fix or named-profile exclusion is committed, reviewed, merged, green in required CI on the exact credited commit, and bound to immutable replayable evidence.

A count-only group cannot be closed, excluded, waived, or credited. It must first be expanded into the declared number of individually identified entries with stable IDs, deployment applicability, exact evidence, and closure criteria.

Fail-closed containment is not closure while the general lifecycle remains unfinished; it is creditable only as a deployment-profile exclusion that names the unreachable surface and is enforced by a release gate.

closure_criteria: Constructor aliases and accessor values cannot mutate committed balances, their canonical root, or subsequent transition behavior.
The repair and adversarial alias evidence are committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: DexState retains mutable pool mapping and PoolState aliases
closure_criteria: The pool mapping and every PoolState leaf are owned immutable values whose root and behavior survive all caller-alias mutation attempts.
The repair and adversarial alias evidence are committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: DexState retains mutable LPTable balance and duration aliases
closure_criteria: LP balances and duration metadata are transitively owned and cannot change a committed root or LP transition through retained aliases.
The repair and adversarial alias evidence are committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: DexState retains a mutable NonceTable replay-authority alias
closure_criteria: Nonce authority is transitively immutable and retained aliases cannot alter replay admission or the committed root.
The repair and adversarial alias evidence are committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: Intent retains caller-owned mutable fields after signed meaning is established
closure_criteria: Signed and admitted intents own one bounded canonical value whose bytes, hash, and execution semantics survive all input and nested-alias mutation attempts.
The repair and adversarial alias evidence are committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: Accepted DEX effect plans retain mutable Settlement and list aliases
closure_criteria: Accepted Settlement, effect, and receipt graphs are transitively immutable and cannot be changed through constructor, nested, accessor, or reinitialization aliases.

findings.title: Computed settlements bypass the public rejection policy and can commit mixed FILL plus REJECT batches
closure_criteria: Every public settlement transport applies one atomic rejection rule: a batch containing any REJECT produces no state, nonce, balance, reserve, or effect mutation.
Computed and supplied settlement paths share permanent replay evidence on a committed, reviewed, merged, CI-green revision.

findings.title: Exact-out swaps can produce pool reserves above the authoritative kernel domain
closure_criteria: Exact-out admission rejects every transition whose post-reserves exceed the authoritative domain and preserves the exact prestate on rejection.
Boundary, maximum, and maximum-plus-one evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: Exact-in protocol-fee adapters reject valid boundary swaps using gross rather than credited reserve input
closure_criteria: Exact-in reserve-domain validation uses the actual credited reserve input after protocol-fee diversion and accepts or rejects the exact maximum boundary consistently across adapters.
Runtime, kernel, and witness parity evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

deployment_applicability.required_action: Fix the witness relation or enforce a named-profile exclusion for Tau plus nonzero protocol-fee share.

closure_criteria: The Tau witness proves the same protocol-fee debit and post-reserve transition committed by the accepted runtime settlement.
Bidirectional nonzero-fee replay evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision, or an enforced named-profile exclusion is evidenced.

findings.title: Aggregate vault harvest accepts caller-supplied entry state without per-staker entitlement authority

deployment_applicability.required_action: Replace aggregate caller-supplied reward entry state with canonical per-staker shares, reward debt, claimable state, and exact-once authorization, or evidence an enforced named-profile exclusion.

closure_criteria: Each claimant can harvest only rewards earned by that claimant's immutable shares exactly once, and aggregate claims plus residue never exceed funded custody.
Multi-claimant BDD, boundary, permutation, formal, and runtime-refinement evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: CH2P and CH3P settlement omit the typed Oracle authorization enforced by CHNP

deployment_applicability.required_action: Route CH2P, CH3P, and CHNP settlement through one exact typed Oracle-authorization decision, or evidence an enforced named-profile exclusion.

closure_criteria: CH2P, CH3P, and CHNP settlement verify the same market, participant, action, prestate, value, epoch, freshness, dispute, and replay bindings through one typed decision.

findings.title: Global pre-invariant validation makes the partial-liquidation repair transition unreachable

closure_criteria: The native partial-liquidation repair action is reachable only under its exact action-specific precondition while all unrelated pre-invariants, guards, and post-invariants remain enforced.

findings.title: proof_required can be satisfied by unauthenticated metadata or report booleans instead of cryptographic verifier authority

deployment_applicability.required_action: Require a pinned direct verifier result or an authenticated verifier receipt bound to the admitted proof and ledger context, or evidence an enforced named-profile exclusion.

closure_criteria: proof_required and bridge proof-journal admission reject caller-authored success booleans and accept only authenticated verifier facts bound to the exact proof, program, header, state, transaction, chain, and height.
Forgery, replay, substitution, revocation, and exact-once verification evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: The RISC0 spot proof, metadata, and ledger commitment path lacks one complete authenticated binding chain

deployment_applicability.required_action: Close the proof-to-verifier-to-journal-to-metadata-to-header chain through one sealed authenticated result, or evidence an enforced named-profile exclusion.

closure_criteria: One authority-bearing path verifies canonical proof bytes once and binds all journal outputs to independently reconstructed header, transaction, state, context, program, and toolchain commitments without domain confusion.
Cross-block, transaction-order, missing-binding, wrong-domain, and profile-substitution evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.

findings.title: ZRPF settlement admission lacks opaque verified authority, durable exact-once commit, and an economic action nullifier

deployment_applicability.required_action: Require opaque authenticated verifier facts, one durable atomic exact-once admission, and a profile-independent economic action nullifier, or evidence an enforced named-profile exclusion.

closure_criteria: Production admission cannot consume caller-constructed verified facts or bare roots; one atomic commit binds the complete verified proposal and rejects concurrent or cross-encoding duplicate economic actions.
Single-verification, concurrency, nullifier, policy-substitution, and resource-bound evidence is committed, reviewed, merged, and green on the exact credited revision.
